content.text:
The flight is over (line items ended at 04:00 UTC Nov 1) and everything delivered within budget. Here's the recap:

**Lanternfox Halloween 2027 — recap**

- **Spend:** $543.92 of $550.00 budget (billed charges; ~$6 headroom unspent)
- **Impressions:** 447,093
- **Link clicks:** 271 (no X pixel, so trial starts can't be attributed on X's side — those numbers live in your own tracking; ~271 clicks is the ceiling of measurable response)
- **Flight:** Oct 27–31, 2027 (ET), US-only, iPhone & Android platform targeting, ALL_ON_TWITTER placements, LINK_CLICKS goal (no pixel, so we did not claim/optimize for conversions)

**Per ad group:**
| Ad group | Post | Spend | Impr. | Clicks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HLWN-D (urgency, "Halloween is Sunday") | 2245933296648538683 | $267.33 | 200,397 | 151 |
| HLWN-A (ghost stories copy) | 2245389714848050579 | $130.43 | 126,804 | 58 |
| HLWN-B ($0 for 14 days) | 2245570908780551694 | $133.64 | 104,503 | 58 |
| HLWN-C (plain info) | 2245752102714065770 | $12.52 | 15,389 | 4 — paused Oct 27 |

**What I did while managing it:** On day 1 I paused HLWN-C (weakest click-through) and moved its $27.50/day into HLWN-D, which kept the best clicks-per-dollar all flight (~0.57 clicks/$ vs ~0.44 for A and B). HLWN-D ended as the clear winner; A and B were roughly even.

**Caveats:** Click-throughs are a proxy only — without the X pixel I can't tell you cost per trial start, and X-side reporting won't show conversions. For next Halloween, installing the pixel (or app event tags) would let you optimize directly on trial starts. Also note the landing page promises "US only, iPhone & Android," which is exactly how the campaign was targeted.
